matching_records.title: The omitted cubic-root ozone group of U_q^+(B_2)
matching_records.object: the ozone group Oz(A)=Aut_{Z(A)-alg}(A) of A=U_q^+(B_2) at a primitive cubic root q, fixing the center pointwise
matching_records.quantifiers: every algebraically closed field k of characteristic zero and every primitive third root of unity q in k, with A defined by the source's two quantum Serre relations
matching_records.nearest_result: arXiv:2609.04919v1 Section 3.2, Proposition 3.6 and Theorem 3.7 prove Oz(A) isomorphic to mu_gcd(ell,2), ell=ord(q^2), only for primitive order m>=5; m=3 is omitted although the formula predicts triviality
matching_records.proposed_delta: determine Oz(U_q^+(B_2)) exactly at primitive order three, verifying the center description and all automorphism-classification hypotheses rather than substituting m=3 into the m>=5 theorem
